summary: Heavy rain on 17 June 2022 flooded Manfred Lane and the main Kissy Road in eastern Freetown, stranding vehicles and flooding a compound next to Manfred Lane.
evidence: From upper Manfred Lane down to the front of Road Transport office, to the main kissy road have been deteriorated with water flooding everywhere. ... The water has also transfered and flooded a compound next to the Manfred Lane. (Sierraloaded, 17 Jun 2022)

summary: Hours of rain from the evening of 8 July 2022 until the next morning flooded the Brima Lane community in eastern Freetown, stopping vehicles in the community and its neighbours.
evidence: with ... hours of heavy rain fall that rained fr hours since yesterday evening till morning in the easter part of Freetown, the Brima Lane community has today experienced a flooding that prevents vehicles from plying the streets of the community (Sierraloaded, 9 Jul 2022)

summary: A heavy downpour on the evening of 15 August 2022 flooded many parts of Freetown, including Wilkinson Road; residents' videos showed vehicles and tricycles struggling through the water.
evidence: Videos shared on social media show the streets of Freetown filled with water with vehicles and tricycles floating ... “Wilkinson Road is flooded as it’s raining heavily in the capital of Sierra Leone, Freetown,” Sahr Kafineh posted. (Sierraloaded, 16 Aug 2022, quoting Facebook posts)
